units.source_text: 当然，也许时间不会像野马一样飞奔。

en.t: Of course, perhaps time would not gallop away like a wild horse.

units.source_text: 但是，看来它也不会比手推车的速度慢。

en.t: But it did not seem likely to move any slower than a handcart, either.

units.source_text: 眼看着早上的气温，动真格地热起来，眼球和脑浆开始被煮，内脏更是已经烧焦，紧接着，肺开始冒火。

en.t: As the morning temperature visibly began to heat up in earnest, his eyeballs and brain matter started to boil, his internal organs were already scorched, and then his lungs began to catch fire.
